phases.exitGate: Canonical schemas, provenance, formulas, ingestion controls, and fail-closed contracts pass.
Every composite Agility page is split into revision-pinned, independently eligible variants.
Every method eligible at base level 34 has a condition-correct model or an explicit authoritative exclusion.
Exact vectors are manually reviewed and a reproducible level-34 certificate survives challenge.
Every trainable skill has family-specific candidates, mechanics, requirements, variants, and coverage gates.
Items, recipes, equipment, effects, monsters, locations, and prices meet objective-specific completeness gates.
Adversarial fixtures, sensitivity analysis, drift detection, and confidence calibration prevent unsupported best claims.
PostgreSQL, API, workers, refresh jobs, and compatibility interfaces pass isolated integration tests.
The new client covers existing workflows against versioned APIs without altering production.
Architecture, ergonomics, language, accessibility, responsive behavior, and visual cohesion findings are resolved.
Backup, rollback, data reconciliation, load testing, and deployment rehearsal pass.
User explicitly approves the production migration.
